correctness.rationale: Headline claim judged separately: joint class Av(1324,1342) bivariate max-insertion-site profile a(n,k) to length 12 with transfer matrices, dual-verified by two independent engines. Evidence verified: (1) Committed A_joint12_prof.csv and C_joint12_prof.csv are byte-identical (68 cells) and A_joint12_trans.csv / C_joint12_trans.csv byte-identical (277 cells); likewise A_1324_11 vs C_1324_11 and A_1342_11 vs C_1342_11 identical. (2) Recompiled enumA.c and enumB2.c from source and reran independently: joint to n=8 PROF-SAME and TRANS-SAME; Av(1324) to n=9 and n=10 PROF-SAME/TRANS-SAME; Av(1342) to n=9 PROF-SAME; marginals match DRAFT. (3) Transfer identities Sum_j T_m(k->j)=k*a(m,k) and Sum_k T_m(k->j)=a(m+1,j) for m=0..11 verified by independent Python recheck for all three classes (0 failures). (4) Marginals independently anchored to live external rows: OEIS A061552 b-file gives 11->3824112, 12->25431452 exactly matching Engine-A Av(1324); A022558 b-file gives 11->3475090, 12->22214707 exactly matching Av(1342); PermPAL raw record for Av(1324,1342) gives ...206098,1037718,5293446... exactly matching joint marginals. (5) Code review: Engine A 1324 lemma (new max must be pattern-value 4, so forbidden iff prefix before gap contains 132) is correct; 1342 condition (i1<i2<g<=i3 with p[i1]<p[i3]<p[i2]) correctly encodes max as pattern-value 4 at position 3; Engine B2 localized brute force (every new occurrence must use insertion position g because deleting g recovers avoiding parent; ranks recomputed per quadruple) is sound and shares no logic with Engine A. DRAFT honestly qualifies single-class length-12 profiles as single-engine + OEIS-marginal-pinned (Sec.1 and Sec.6), not dual-claimed; this limitation is stated precisely and does not infect the joint-12 headline which is fully dual-certified. DRAFT sums re-added correctly (e.g. joint-12 sums to 5293446; 1324-12 to 25431452; 1342-12 to 22214707). Stanley-Wilf residuals are labeled descriptive only. No proof vs experiment confusion: result is presented as certified finite enumeration, not a general theorem. Therefore the headline exact census is correct as a computed certified fact.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp/search: nearest prior sources contain only marginals, generating functions, asymptotics, or specifications, not the claimed (n,k) active-site bivariate tables. OEIS A061552 (Av1324) and A022558 (Av1342) b-files fetched live contain only marginal sequences (to n=50+ / 200); no (n,k) column. Bona math/9702223 gives closed algebraic GF for Av(1342) marginals only; does not yield site distribution without new enumeration. Conway-Guttmann-Zinn-Justin 1709.01248 extends Av(1324) marginals to n=50 with stretched-exponential fit mu~11.6, no site profiles or joint certificate. Bevan 1406.2890 proves growth >9.81 via Lukasiewicz paths, no (n,k) census. PermPAL Av(1324,1342) record fetched live gives joint marginals 1,1,2,6,22,90,394,1806,8558,41586,206098,1037718,5293446... with closed GF -x/2+3/2-sqrt(x^2-6x+1)/2, recurrence, and tiling specifications, but no explicit (n,k) active-site profile table to n=12; tracked-fusion equations track a catalytic variable but do not publish the numerical bivariate census. Classical 513-vs-512 separation at length 6 (DRAFT convention; n=7 in OEIS offset) is explicitly disclaimed as audit anchor, not claimed new. Internal prior scan hits SCOPE022 (inversion distribution for triple {1324,1243,1432}) and SCOPE073 (substitution-decomposition census) use different statistics/classes and do not imply insertion-site profiles. The algebraic 1342 GF and large-Schroeder joint GF do not mechanically imply the site distribution. Hence the joint-12 dual-verified profile (and singles-11 dual profiles + profile-level separation at length 5) are new refinements.

value.rationale: Independently worth retrieving under the narrow-datum rule: object (Av(1324), Av(1342), and natural pair Av(1324,1342)=large-Schroeder class) and invariant (max-insertion active-site count, the canonical insertion-encoding statistic) were motivated before computation by the notorious 1324 enumeration problem, length-4 Wilf-classification, insertion-encoding succession theory, and Stanley-Wilf growth studies (Bona, Vatter, Bevan, Conway-Guttmann-Zinn-Justin). Value was not known or mechanically implied: marginals to n=50+ were known but profiles were not in any source inspected. A future researcher in enumeration schemes / generating trees / growth-rate fitting could reasonably need the precise dual-certified table (68 joint cells + 277 transfer cells, marginal 5293446 at length 12; profile-level separation of singles already at length 5: 11,22,28,42 vs 12,21,28,42) as benchmark rows. This is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration: exact counts are fully interpreted (definitions, succession, transfer identities) and replayable in seconds/minutes via committed stdlib-only C + Python verifier. Certification alone is not the value claim; the substantive refinement + natural object provide it. The honestly-qualified single-12 extensions do not erase the headline joint-12 value; incomplete surrounding census is described honestly per DRAFT Sec.1/6.

residual_risks: Full joint-12 Engine-B2 rerun (~5 min per DRAFT) was not repeated in audit; joint-12 dual claim rests on committed byte-identical files plus transfer-identity checks, external Schroeder marginal match, and audit spot-reruns to n=8-10. A third-party replay is prescribed.

Single-class length-12 profiles are single-engine + OEIS-marginal-pinned only; audit confirms DRAFT states this honestly, but those two rows carry higher residual risk than the dual-verified headline and must be cited with that qualification.

Literature search was bounded to title/abstract/theorem level and live fetches of the nearest rows/database records; a differently-termed active-site table in unpublished code or thesis cannot be logically excluded, though no such table was found.
Indexing offset (DRAFT length n vs 1-indexed OEIS n+1) is a known confusion hazard; DRAFT Sec.0 states the shift explicitly and audit verified alignment term-by-term.
